segments.sn35.77:1.1: “Yaṃ kho, rādha, dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.77:1.3: Cakkhu kho, rādha, dukkhaṃ. Tatra te chando pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.77:1.4: Rūpā … cakkhuviññāṇaṃ … cakkhusamphasso … yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassa … pe … adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn35.77:1.7: Tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe … mano dukkho … dhammā … manoviññāṇaṃ … manosamphasso … yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn35.77:1.13: Yaṃ kho, rādha, dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo”ti.
